title: NYC Gets 1,918 Noise Calls Every Day
hook: NYC noise complaints doubled to 1,918 calls every day.
closing: The city that never sleeps also never stops reporting the noise.
question: What is your loudest neighbor?

segments.say: Noise makes up 18% of NYC complaints, nearly 1 in 5.
NYC noise complaints doubled from 350,000 in 2010 to 700,000 in 2023.
NYC now gets 1,918 noise calls daily versus 959 in 2010.
